    x_min, x_max = sandbox.get_corridor_bounds()
    seeker_pos = sandbox.get_seeker_position()
    seeker_x, seeker_y = seeker_pos
    margin = 0.02

    if seeker_x < x_min - margin or seeker_x > x_max + margin:
        # Calculate thrust direction to return to corridor
        if seeker_x < x_min - margin:
            thrust = 100.0
        else:
            thrust = -100.0
        sandbox.apply_seeker_force(thrust, 0)
    
    # Activation phase
    if not agent_body.activated:
        # Check if in activation zone
        if 13.0 <= seeker_x <= 17.0:
            agent_body.activation_count += 1
        else:

        if seeker_x < x_min - margin or seeker_x > x_max + margin:

        else:

        if agent_body.activated:
            center_x = 15.0

                remaining_budget = sandbox.get_remaining_impulse_budget()
                if remaining_budget >= 0:

                current_angle = sandbox.get_seeker_heading()
                desired_angle = math.atan2(dir_y, dir_x)
                heading_diff = abs(desired_angle - current_angle)
